name: Sagittal Band Rupture / Boxer Knuckle
definition: Rupture of the sagittal band stabilizing the extensor tendon over the MCP joint, causing tendon subluxation and painful snapping.

investigations.principle: Dynamic ultrasound or MRI can demonstrate tendon subluxation and sagittal-band injury.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, labral, tendon, ligament, infection, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: MCP extension/yoke splinting in suitable acute injuries
amber: Chronic or persistent instability may require surgical repair/reconstruction.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Hasta/Anguli-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Rupture of the sagittal band stabilizing the extensor tendon over the MCP joint, causing tendon subluxation and painful snapping.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, rapidly progressive weakness, suspected serious infection, airway/vascular symptoms, unreduced dislocation or other listed red flags.
